entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A dragon spirit and kami of the veil between Kamigawa's realms and the Worldsoul of the plane, once part of O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where Kyodai is Worldsoul.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: The kami of all things, parent of Kyodai, defeated in the Kami War.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: The first emperor to channel with Kyodai, daughter of Takeshi Konda, who fights beside Kyodai.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: The daimyo who stole the kami from the spirit realm and imprisoned it, beginning the Kami War.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: The man who stole The Taken One from Eiganjo and freed the spirit with a ritual.

entities.name: Sisters of Flesh and Spirit
entities.description: The name for Michiko and Kyodai together as guardians of the barrier between realms.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war begun when Konda's theft awoke O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Kakuriyo
entities.description: The spirit realm of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Utsushiyo
entities.description: The mortal realm of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: The capital city from which The Taken One was stolen and where a civil war broke out.

entities.name: Leshrac Nightwalker
entities.description: A planeswalker ordered away from Kamigawa by the Sisters.

entities.name: Konda family
entities.description: The imperial family stripped of its hereditary duty to rule by Kyodai.

entities.name: Yamazaki clan
entities.description: A clan that served the Konda military, one of whom assassinated an emperor's husband.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: The Kami of the Spark, embodiment of the emperor's relationship with Kyodai.

entities.name: The Wandering Emperor
entities.description: A planeswalker emperor who disappeared and returned, bonded to Kyodai.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who tried to control Kyodai with a prototype Reality Chip.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: A character appointed acting Regent of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kaito
entities.description: A character rescued by the emperor during the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A character who was compleated and killed by the emperor.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: The place near the Imperial residence where Kyodai has a prominent temple.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which the Wanderer returned and oni escaped into the mortal realm.

events.summary: Takeshi Konda steals the essence of a kami from the Kakuriyo on the night of Michiko's birth, imprisoning it and awakening O-Kagachi, beginning the Kami War.
events.quote: this act awoke the prisoner's parent, beginning the Kami War .

events.summary: Toshiro Umezawa steals The Taken One from Eiganjo and performs a ritual to free the spirit, who takes the name Kyodai.
Kyodai brings Michiko into the Kakuriyo and gives her the power to fight alongside her.
events.quote: After that, she gave Michiko the power to fight alongside her.

events.summary: Michiko and Kyodai defeat Konda and O-Kagachi and become guardians of the barrier between realms.
events.quote: defeated Konda and O-Kagachi and claimed themselves the guardians of the barrier between the Utsushiyo and the Kakuriyo.

events.summary: Centuries later the Sisters order Leshrac to leave their plane.
events.quote: the Sisters stood in his way and ordered him to go away from their plane.

events.summary: A Yamazaki soldier assassinates the late emperor's husband during a succession civil war, and Kyodai strips the Konda family of its right to rule.
events.quote: She stripped the Konda family of their hereditary duty as rulers.

events.summary: Tezzeret tries to control Kyodai with a prototype Reality Chip, destabilizing the emperor's spark and leaving Kyodai dazed.
events.quote: the planeswalker Tezzeret attempted to control Kyodai using a prototype Reality Chip .

events.summary: The emperor returns and appoints Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.
events.quote: the two agreed to appoint Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.

events.summary: Kyodai's power flows through the emperor to rescue Kaito and kill compleated Tamiyo; oni escape into the mortal realm.
events.quote: Kyodai's power flowed through the emperor, helping her rescue Kaito and kill the compleated Tamiyo .

relations.note: Fight together as the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit.
relations.quote: Michiko and Kyodai, known together as the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit
On the night of his daughter Michiko 's birth

relations.note: Described as the great kami's core, child, and scion.
relations.quote: she has been described as the great kami's core, child, and scion

relations.note: Imprisoned her in a stone disk.
relations.quote: Konda imprisoned The Taken One in a stone disk with the carving of a dragon

relations.note: Himoto embodies the emperor's relationship with Kyodai.
relations.quote: is the embodiment of the emperor's relationship with Kyodai.
